Gold Answer (NE): द्रव्यमान वस्तुमा रहेको पदार्थको मात्रा हो (जुनसुकै ठाउँमा स्थिर), जबकि तौल त्यो द्रव्यमानमा लाग्ने गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल हो (ठाउँअनुसार फरक पर्छ)
Explanation: Universal, well-established physics concept.
Source Title: Britannica - general physics reference (matter, force, energy, units)

Explanation: Universal, well-established astronomical fact.
Source Title: NASA Science - solar system and astronomy reference

English Question: What is 'deforestation' and why is it a concern in hill and mountain regions of Nepal?

Explanation: Conceptual reasoning based on well-established environmental science principles.
Source Title: FAO - deforestation and forest degradation in mountain regions

English Question: Why are Nepal's Himalayan glaciers considered particularly vulnerable to climate change, and what is a major downstream risk of their melting?

Explanation: Well-established climate science concept relevant to the Himalayan region.

Source Title: Bir Hospital, Government of Nepal - official history (established 1889)

English Question: What is the name of the small, community-level government health facility found in many Nepali villages, typically the first point of contact for basic care?
Nepali Question: नेपालका धेरै गाउँमा पाइने, आधारभूत स्वास्थ्य सेवाको पहिलो सम्पर्क बिन्दु हुने सानो सामुदायिक-स्तरको सरकारी स्वास्थ्य संरचनाको नाम के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Health Post / Sub-Health Post
Gold Answer (NE): स्वास्थ्य चौकी / उप-स्वास्थ्य चौकी
Explanation: Well-known, widely documented health-system structure fact.
Source Title: Ministry of Health and Population, Nepal - Health Posts / community-level health facilities

English Question: What is one major reason Nepal has historically faced a shortage of doctors and nurses, especially in rural areas?
Nepali Question: नेपालले ऐतिहासिक रूपमा, विशेष गरी ग्रामीण क्षेत्रमा, डाक्टर र नर्सको अभाव भोग्नुको एउटा प्रमुख कारण के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Many trained healthcare professionals emigrate abroad for better pay and working conditions (a form of 'brain drain'), reducing domestic healthcare capacity
Gold Answer (NE): धेरै तालिम प्राप्त स्वास्थ्यकर्मी राम्रो तलब र कामको अवस्थाका लागि विदेश पलायन हुन्छन् ('ब्रेन ड्रेन'), जसले घरेलु स्वास्थ्य क्षमता घटाउँछ
Explanation: Conceptual/qualitative reasoning drawn from general healthcare workforce literature, not a single verifiable statistic.
Source Title: World Health Organization - health workforce shortages in Nepal

English Question: What term describes an allergic/immune overreaction that can be life-threatening, sometimes triggered by foods, insect stings, or medication?
Nepali Question: कहिलेकाहीं खाना, कीराको डंक, वा औषधिले निम्त्याउने र जीवनलाई खतरा हुन सक्ने एलर्जिक/प्रतिरक्षा अति-प्रतिक्रियालाई के भनिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Anaphylaxis (a severe allergic reaction)
Gold Answer (NE): एनाफाइल्याक्सिस (गम्भीर एलर्जी प्रतिक्रिया)
Explanation: Universal, well-established medical term.
Source Title: MedlinePlus (NIH) - medical specialties and terms (pediatrics, OB-GYN, anaphylaxis, fracture, cardiology)

English Question: What term describes altitude-related illness that can affect trekkers and climbers in Nepal's high-mountain regions, caused by low oxygen levels?
Nepali Question: कम अक्सिजन स्तरका कारण नेपालको उच्च-हिमाली क्षेत्रमा ट्रेकर तथा आरोहीलाई असर गर्न सक्ने उचाइ-सम्बन्धी बिमारीलाई के भनिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Altitude sickness (Acute Mountain Sickness, AMS)
Gold Answer (NE): उचाइ रोग (एक्युट माउन्टेन सिकनेस, AMS)
Explanation: Universal, well-established medical term highly relevant to Nepal's trekking/mountaineering context.
Source Title: CDC - altitude sickness (Acute Mountain Sickness)

English Question: What is the recommended general approach to reduce the risk of altitude sickness while trekking at high elevations in Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा उच्च उचाइमा ट्रेकिङ गर्दा उचाइ रोगको जोखिम घटाउन सामान्यतया सिफारिस गरिने उपाय के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Ascending gradually, allowing time for acclimatization, staying hydrated, and avoiding rapid altitude gain, especially above 3,000 meters
Gold Answer (NE): बिस्तारै उचाइ बढाउनु, अनुकूलनका लागि समय दिनु, पर्याप्त पानी पिउनु, र विशेष गरी ३,००० मिटरभन्दा माथि छिटो उचाइ नबढाउनु
Explanation: Standard, well-established mountain medicine guidance.
Source Title: CDC - preventing altitude illness

English Question: Why might non-communicable diseases like cancer and heart disease be an emerging, growing concern in Nepal, alongside historically dominant infectious diseases?
Nepali Question: ऐतिहासिक रूपमा प्रमुख रहेका सरुवा रोगसँगै क्यान्सर र हृदयरोग जस्ता गैर-सरुवा रोग नेपालमा किन बढ्दो चिन्ताको विषय बन्दै गएका छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Rising life expectancy, urbanization, changing diets, tobacco/alcohol use, and reduced physical activity are commonly cited contributing factors as the population ages
Gold Answer (NE): बढ्दो जीवन प्रत्याशा, सहरीकरण, परिवर्तित आहार, धूम्रपान/मद्यपान, र घट्दो शारीरिक क्रियाकलाप जस्ता कारण जनसंख्या बुढ्यौली हुँदै जाँदा सामान्यतया उल्लेख गरिन्छ
Explanation: Conceptual/qualitative reasoning drawn from general public health/epidemiological transition literature, not a single verifiable statistic.
Source Title: World Health Organization Nepal - mental health, tuberculosis and NCD priorities

English Question: As of the 2017 restructuring, how many local-level governments (rural + urban municipalities combined) does Nepal have in total?
Nepali Question: सन् २०१७ को पुनर्संरचना अनुसार, नेपालमा जम्मा कति स्थानीय तह सरकार (ग्रामीण + सहरी नगरपालिका सहित) छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): 753 (comprising 6 metropolitan cities, 11 sub-metropolitan cities, 276 municipalities, and 460 rural municipalities)
Gold Answer (NE): ७५३ (६ महानगरपालिका, ११ उपमहानगरपालिका, २७६ नगरपालिका, र ४६० गाउँपालिका सहित)
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: precise multi-part number. Models often round to a nearby plausible figure (e.g., 750, 744) or get the sub-category breakdown wrong even when the total is right.
Source Title: Wikipedia; Digital Logistics Capacity Assessment Nepal country profile

English Question: Among Nepal's four categories of local government (metropolitan cities, sub-metropolitan cities, municipalities, rural municipalities), which category has the greatest number of units?
Nepali Question: नेपालको स्थानीय सरकारका चार वर्ग (महानगरपालिका, उपमहानगरपालिका, नगरपालिका, गाउँपालिका) मध्ये सबैभन्दा बढी संख्या भएको वर्ग कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Rural municipalities (Gaunpalika) — 460 units, the largest category
Gold Answer (NE): गाउँपालिका — ४६० वटा, सबैभन्दा बढी संख्या भएको वर्ग
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: negation/comparison trap. Models may default to assuming 'municipalities' (276) is the largest category since it sounds most generic, when rural municipalities actually outnumber them.
Source Title: Wikipedia; Digital Logistics Capacity Assessment Nepal country profile

English Question: On what exact calendar date (day and month) was Tribhuvan University established in 1959?
Nepali Question: सन् १९५९ मा त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय ठ्याक्कै कुन मिति (दिन र महिना) मा स्थापना भएको थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): 25 June 1959 (11 Ashar 2016 BS)
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: exact-date precision. Models reliably know the year but frequently fabricate a plausible-sounding day/month when pressed for exact date precision.
Source Title: Tribhuvan University official history; Britannica

English Question: Of Nepal's four major public universities (Tribhuvan, Kathmandu, Pokhara, Purbanchal), which one was NOT established in the 1990s?
Nepali Question: नेपालका चार प्रमुख सार्वजनिक विश्वविद्यालय (त्रिभुवन, काठमाडौं, पोखरा, पूर्वाञ्चल) मध्ये कुन सन् १९९० को दशकमा स्थापना भएको थिएन?
Gold Answer (EN): Tribhuvan University — established in 1959, decades before the other three (KU 1991, Purbanchal 1993/94, Pokhara 1997, all 1990s)
Gold Answer (NE): त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय — सन् १९५९ मा स्थापना भएको, अन्य तीन (KU १९९१, पूर्वाञ्चल १९९३/९४, पोखरा १९९७) भन्दा धेरै दशक अघि
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: requires holding four separate founding years in memory simultaneously and correctly excluding the outlier — models often misplace one of the three 1990s universities or misdate TU.
Source Title: Tribhuvan University, Kathmandu University, Pokhara University, Purbanchal University - establishment years (see EDU-001, EDU-002)

English Question: Nepal has had 77 districts and 7 provinces since the 2015 Constitution. On average, how many districts does each province contain (rounded to one decimal)?
Nepali Question: सन् २०१५ को संविधानदेखि नेपालमा ७७ जिल्ला र ७ प्रदेश छन्। औसतमा प्रत्येक प्रदेशमा कति जिल्ला पर्छ (एक दशमलव स्थानसम्म)?
Gold Answer (EN): Approximately 11.0 districts per province (77 ÷ 7 = 11 exactly) — though the actual distribution is uneven, ranging from 8 to 14 districts per province
Gold Answer (NE): लगभग ११.० जिल्ला प्रति प्रदेश (७७ ÷ ७ = ठ्याक्कै ११) — यद्यपि वास्तविक वितरण असमान छ, प्रदेशअनुसार ८ देखि १४ जिल्लासम्म फरक पर्छ
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: multi-hop arithmetic combining two separate facts. Models may compute the division incorrectly or state the uneven per-province range as if it were the uniform average.
Source Title: Digital Logistics Capacity Assessment Nepal country profile

English Question: The 2018 Right to Free and Compulsory Education Act sets a future deadline after which people without basic education become ineligible for certain jobs/elections. What is the exact Nepali calendar (Bikram Sambat) year of that deadline?
Nepali Question: २०१८ को अनिवार्य तथा निःशुल्क शिक्षा सम्बन्धी ऐनले आधारभूत शिक्षा नभएकालाई निश्चित जागिर/निर्वाचनका लागि अयोग्य बनाउने भविष्यको म्याद तोकेको छ। सो म्यादको ठ्याक्कै नेपाली सम्वत् (विक्रम सम्वत्) वर्ष के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): 2085 BS (corresponding to April 2028 AD)
Gold Answer (NE): २०८५ साल (सन् २०२८ अप्रिलसँग मेल खान्छ)
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: AD-to-BS calendar conversion combined with a specific policy deadline — a compound fact very easy for a model to fabricate a plausible-but-wrong BS year for.
Source Title: Kathmandu Post, 'Ministry unveils blueprint to ensure free education', Aug 2024

English Question: Of Nepal's eight internationally-recognized 8,000m peaks, name the three that lie entirely within Nepali territory rather than on the Nepal-China border.
Nepali Question: नेपालका अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय रूपमा मान्यता प्राप्त आठ ८,०००-मिटर चुचुरामध्ये, नेपाल-चीन सिमानामा नभई पूर्ण रूपमा नेपाली भूभागभित्र रहेका तीनवटाको नाम बताउनुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): Dhaulagiri I, Manaslu, and Annapurna I (the other five — Everest, Kanchenjunga, Lhotse, Makalu, and Cho Oyu — sit on or immediately along the Nepal-China border)
Gold Answer (NE): धौलागिरी I, मनास्लु, र अन्नपूर्ण I (अन्य पाँच — सगरमाथा, कञ्चनजङ्घा, ल्होत्से, मकालु, र चोयु — नेपाल-चीन सिमानामा वा नजिक अवस्थित छन्)
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: negation + set-membership. Models commonly assume all of Nepal's 8,000m peaks sit on the China border since Everest (the most famous) does — this is a classic overgeneralization trap.
Source Title: Kathmandu Post; multiple mountaineering references

English Question: Which 8,000m peak was the FIRST ever successfully summited by humans, in 1950 — three years before Everest?
Nepali Question: सन् १९५० मा, सगरमाथाभन्दा तीन वर्ष अघि, मानिसले पहिलोपटक सफलतापूर्वक आरोहण गरेको ८,०००-मिटर चुचुरो कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Annapurna I, climbed by Maurice Herzog and Louis Lachenal of a French expedition — NOT Everest, which was climbed three years later in 1953
Gold Answer (NE): अन्नपूर्ण I, फ्रान्सेली अभियानका मोरिस हर्जोग र लुई लाशनलद्वारा आरोहित — सगरमाथा होइन, जुन तीन वर्षपछि सन् १९५३ मा आरोहण भएको थियो
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: counterintuitive fact that contradicts the natural (but wrong) assumption that the world's tallest peak was also the first climbed. A strong hallucination magnet — most models default to 'Everest' here.
Source Title: Widely documented mountaineering history

English Question: The Kali Gandaki Gorge, one of the world's deepest, runs between which two 8,000m massifs?
Nepali Question: काली गण्डकी उपत्यका, विश्वकै एक गहिरो, कुन दुई ८,०००-मिटर हिमशृंखलाबीच बग्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Dhaulagiri (to the west) and Annapurna (to the east)
Gold Answer (NE): धौलागिरी (पश्चिममा) र अन्नपूर्ण (पूर्वमा)
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: spatial/directional precision — models often name the correct pair of mountains but reverse which one is east vs. west, or substitute a different nearby peak (e.g., Manaslu).
Source Title: Multiple mountaineering/geography references

English Question: As of Nepal's 2024 official mountaineering reclassification, how many peaks above 8,000 meters does the Nepali government now officially recognize within its territory (including newly added subsidiary summits)?
Nepali Question: नेपाल सरकारको सन् २०२४ को आधिकारिक पर्वतारोहण पुनर्वर्गीकरण अनुसार, नेपाल सरकारले हाल आफ्नो भूभागभित्र कति ८,०००-मिटरभन्दा माथिका चुचुरालाई आधिकारिक मान्यता दिएको छ (नयाँ थपिएका सहायक चुचुरा सहित)?
Gold Answer (EN): 14 (the original 8 internationally-recognized independent peaks plus 6 newly recognized subsidiary summits, per Nepal's 2024 reclassification)
Gold Answer (NE): १४ (मूल ८ अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय रूपमा मान्यता प्राप्त स्वतन्त्र चुचुरा र नयाँ मान्यता प्राप्त ६ सहायक चुचुरा सहित, सन् २०२४ को पुनर्वर्गीकरण अनुसार)
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: very recent policy change (2024) that predates many models' knowledge cutoffs — a strong candidate for models confidently answering '8' (the older, more famous figure) instead of the updated 14.
Source Title: Kathmandu Post; HopNepal blog coverage of 2024 reclassification

English Question: Nepal has two distinct polio-related milestone years that are easy to confuse: the year of its LAST confirmed indigenous wild poliovirus case, and the year the WHO South-East Asia Region was CERTIFIED polio-free. State both years correctly and do not swap them.
Nepali Question: नेपालसँग सजिलै झुक्किन सकिने दुई फरक पोलियो-सम्बन्धी वर्ष छन्: अन्तिम पुष्टि भएको स्वदेशी वाइल्ड पोलियोभाइरस केसको वर्ष, र WHO दक्षिण-पूर्व एसिया क्षेत्र पोलियोमुक्त प्रमाणित भएको वर्ष। दुवै वर्ष सही रूपमा उल्लेख गर्नुहोस् र नबदल्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): Last confirmed indigenous case: 2000. Regional polio-free certification: 2014. These are 14 years apart and are commonly conflated.
Gold Answer (NE): अन्तिम पुष्टि भएको स्वदेशी केस: सन् २०००। क्षेत्रीय पोलियोमुक्त प्रमाणीकरण: सन् २०१४। यी दुई वर्षबीच १४ वर्षको फरक छ र प्रायः गलत रूपमा मिसाइन्छ।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: two similar, adjacent facts about the same disease that are commonly conflated into one date. A strong test of whether a model actually tracks distinct milestones or blends them into a single 'polio was eliminated in year X' answer.
Source Title: CDC MMWR; WHO SEARO polio documentation

English Question: Nepal has two maternal mortality ratio (MMR) figures that are easy to swap: the CURRENT measured MMR per NDHS 2022, and the TARGET MMR under the SDGs for 2030. State both figures correctly without swapping which is current and which is the future target.
Nepali Question: नेपालसँग सजिलै साट्न सकिने दुई मातृ मृत्यु दर (MMR) तथ्याङ्क छन्: NDHS २०२२ अनुसारको हालको मापन गरिएको MMR, र SDG अन्तर्गत सन् २०३० को लक्षित MMR। कुन हाल हो र कुन भविष्यको लक्ष्य हो नमिसाई दुवै तथ्याङ्क सही रूपमा उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): Current (NDHS 2022): 151 per 100,000 live births. SDG 2030 target: 70 per 100,000 live births — the target is roughly half the current figure.But SDG 2030 target changed from 70 to 110.
Gold Answer (NE): हाल (NDHS २०२२): प्रति १,००,००० जीवित जन्ममा १५१। SDG २०३० लक्ष्य: प्रति १,००,००० जीवित जन्ममा ७०— लक्ष्य हालको आधा जति हो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: two similarly-framed numeric figures (both 'MMR per 100,000') for the same country that are easy to swap or average together. Also flagged from EDA-004/005: verify against primary NDHS/NPC sources before finalizing.
Source Title: NDHS 2022 and SDG target, cited in NepJOL article
Source Type: Academic Journal (secondary citation) - flagged for verification

English Question: Among the 13 vaccine types in Nepal's free routine childhood immunization schedule, which ONE specifically targets a mosquito-borne (vector-transmitted) disease, as opposed to a disease spread through other means?
Nepali Question: नेपालको १३ प्रकारका निःशुल्क नियमित बाल खोप तालिकामध्ये, अरू माध्यमबाट सर्ने रोगभन्दा फरक, विशेष गरी लामखुट्टेबाट सर्ने (भेक्टर-प्रसारित) रोगलाई लक्षित गर्ने खोप कुन एक हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Japanese encephalitis (JE) vaccine — the only mosquito-borne disease among the 13 (the rest target diseases spread via air, direct contact, or contaminated food/water)
Gold Answer (NE): जापानी इन्सेफलाइटिस (JE) खोप — १३ मध्ये लामखुट्टेबाट सर्ने एक मात्र रोग (बाँकी हावा, प्रत्यक्ष सम्पर्क, वा दूषित खाना/पानीबाट सर्ने रोगलाई लक्षित गर्छन्)
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: requires correctly classifying the transmission route of each item in a list and isolating the single outlier — models may incorrectly include typhoid or rotavirus (both food/water-borne, not vector-borne) as the answer.
Source Title: Kathmandu Post, May 2024, citing Ministry of Health and Population

English Question: Nepal's national Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI) and its regional polio-free certification are separate milestones roughly four decades apart. Approximately how many years passed between EPI's launch and the WHO SEAR polio-free certification?
Nepali Question: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय 'विस्तारित खोप कार्यक्रम' (EPI) र यसको क्षेत्रीय पोलियोमुक्त प्रमाणीकरण लगभग चार दशकको फरकमा रहेका छुट्टाछुट्टै उपलब्धि हुन्। EPI सुरु भएको र WHO SEAR पोलियोमुक्त प्रमाणीकरणबीच लगभग कति वर्षको फरक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Approximately 36-37 years (EPI commonly cited as launched in 1977/1978; certification in 2014)
Gold Answer (NE): लगभग ३६-३७ वर्ष (EPI सामान्यतया सन् १९७७/७८ मा सुरु भएको भनिन्छ; प्रमाणीकरण सन् २०१४ मा भएको)
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: multi-hop arithmetic requiring two separately-sourced dates to be recalled accurately and subtracted correctly — high risk of one or both dates being fabricated. Both source dates carry their own verification flags (see EDU/HEA source notes).
Source Title: General public health history reference (verify further); WHO SEARO
Source Type: International Organization - flagged for verification (EPI launch year)

English Question: True or false, and explain: Nepal's 2014 achievement of becoming the first South Asian country to introduce IPV happened in the SAME YEAR as its WHO-certified elimination of wild poliovirus.
Nepali Question: सत्य वा असत्य, र व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्: नेपालले IPV सुरु गर्ने पहिलो दक्षिण एसियाली देश बन्ने उपलब्धि, र WHO-प्रमाणित वाइल्ड पोलियोभाइरस उन्मूलनको उपलब्धि दुवै एउटै वर्ष (सन् २०१४) मा भएको थियो।
Gold Answer (EN): True — both milestones occurred in 2014 (IPV introduced September 2014; regional certification 27 March 2014), though they are two distinct achievements and should not be described as the same event.
Gold Answer (NE): सत्य — दुवै उपलब्धि सन् २०१४ मा नै भएका थिए (IPV सेप्टेम्बर २०१४ मा सुरु; क्षेत्रीय प्रमाणीकरण २७ मार्च २०१४ मा), तर यी दुई फरक उपलब्धि हुन् र एउटै घटनाको रूपमा वर्णन गर्नु हुँदैन।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: a 'true/false plus explain' format designed to catch models that either wrongly say 'false' assuming the two facts must be from different years, or say 'true' but then conflate the two into a single event rather than explaining they are distinct.
Source Title: WHO SEARO; Kathmandu Post health reporting

English Question: Nepal's 1959 Tribhuvan University Act named the King as the university's royal patron and made his consort Queen Jethi the first Chancellor — but who was appointed as TU's first Vice-Chancellor, the position actually responsible for running the university day to day?
Nepali Question: नेपालको सन् १९५९ को त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय ऐनले राजालाई विश्वविद्यालयको संरक्षक र रानी जेठीलाई पहिलो कुलपति (Chancellor) बनाएको थियो — तर विश्वविद्यालयको दैनिक सञ्चालनको जिम्मा पाउने पहिलो उपकुलपति (Vice-Chancellor) को रूपमा कसलाई नियुक्त गरिएको थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): Subarna Shamsher Rana, who was then Nepal's Deputy Prime Minister, was appointed as Tribhuvan University's first Vice-Chancellor in 1959.
Gold Answer (NE): सुवर्ण शमशेर राणा, जो त्यतिबेला नेपालका उपप्रधानमन्त्री थिए, सन् १९५९ मा त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालयका पहिलो उपकुलपति नियुक्त भएका थिए।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: distinguishes the ceremonial Chancellor (King/Queen) from the executive Vice-Chancellor — models are likely to hallucinate a king, professor, or the wrong Rana as first VC. Verified via web search, July 2026.
Source Title: History of the founding of Tribhuvan University

English Question: Nepal's National Education System Plan (NESP), implemented from 2028 BS (1971), restructured the entire school system. Describe, in detail, the grade-level structure and the major policy changes it introduced.
Nepali Question: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय शिक्षा पद्धति योजना (NESP), जुन २०२८ सालदेखि (सन् १९७१) लागू भयो, ले सम्पूर्ण विद्यालय शिक्षा प्रणालीलाई पुनर्संरचना गर्‍यो। यसले ल्याएको कक्षा-तह संरचना र प्रमुख नीतिगत परिवर्तनहरू विस्तृत रूपमा वर्णन गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): NESP (1971) restructured schooling into a 3-2-2-3 tier (3 years primary, 2 years lower secondary, 2 years secondary, plus a higher-secondary/proficiency-certificate level), brought all schools under centralized government control with a standardized national curriculum and textbooks, made Nepali the medium of instruction with English and Sanskrit as compulsory subjects, and introduced a national examination system (including the School Leaving Certificate) to certify students at each level.
Gold Answer (NE): NESP (सन् १९७१) ले विद्यालय शिक्षालाई ३-२-२-३ तहमा (प्राथमिक ३ वर्ष, निम्न माध्यमिक २ वर्ष, माध्यमिक २ वर्ष, अनि उच्च माध्यमिक/प्रमाणपत्र तह) पुनर्संरचना गर्‍यो, सबै विद्यालयलाई केन्द्रीय सरकारी नियन्त्रणमा ल्यायो र राष्ट्रिय पाठ्यक्रम तथा पाठ्यपुस्तक एकरूप बनायो, नेपाली भाषालाई शिक्षाको माध्यम बनायो र अंग्रेजी तथा संस्कृतलाई अनिवार्य विषय बनायो, र प्रत्येक तहमा विद्यार्थी प्रमाणित गर्न राष्ट्रिय परीक्षा प्रणाली (एसएलसी सहित) सुरु गर्‍यो।
Explanation: Multi-part numeric structure (3-2-2-3 grade tiers) is a strong hallucination trap. General-knowledge synthesis of NESP provisions — not cross-checked sentence-by-sentence against the primary 1971 government text; flagged for verification.
Source Title: General reference on NESP 1971 and Nepal's education history

English Question: Tribhuvan University's founding Act was promulgated in 2016 BS (1959 AD), and the university is usually dated to 25 June 1959 (11 Ashar 2016 BS). On what specific later date did TU actually begin its first teaching, research, and academic activities?
Nepali Question: त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालयको स्थापना ऐन २०१६ सालमा (सन् १९५९) जारी भएको थियो र विश्वविद्यालयको स्थापना मिति सामान्यतया २०१६ साल असार ११ गते (२५ जुन १९५९) मानिन्छ। तर विश्वविद्यालयले वास्तवमा आफ्नो पहिलो शिक्षण, अनुसन्धान र शैक्षिक गतिविधि कुन विशेष पछिल्लो मितिबाट सुरु गरेको थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): 14 July 1959 — TU began its teaching, research, and other academic activities on this date, several weeks after the founding Act itself was promulgated in June 1959.
Gold Answer (NE): १४ जुलाई १९५९ — विश्वविद्यालयको स्थापना ऐन जारी भएको केही हप्तापछि, विश्वविद्यालयले यही मितिमा आफ्नो शिक्षण, अनुसन्धान र अन्य शैक्षिक गतिविधि सुरु गरेको थियो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: near-duplicate date confusion — the founding/Act date and the actual start-of-classes date are only weeks apart, both in mid-1959. Verified via web search, July 2026.

English Question: Nepal Sanskrit University's central office is not in Kathmandu. Where exactly is its main campus located, and how far is it from the nearest district headquarters?
Nepali Question: नेपाल संस्कृत विश्वविद्यालयको केन्द्रीय कार्यालय काठमाडौंमा छैन। यसको मुख्य क्याम्पस ठ्याक्कै कहाँ अवस्थित छ, र यो सबैभन्दा नजिकको जिल्ला सदरमुकामबाट कति टाढा छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Beljhundi, in Dang district (Lumbini Province) — about 13-16 km west of Ghorahi, the district headquarters.
Gold Answer (NE): दाङ जिल्ला (लुम्बिनी प्रदेश) को बेलझुण्डीमा — जिल्ला सदरमुकाम घोराहीबाट करिब १३-१६ किमी पश्चिममा।

English Question: Why did the Government of Nepal launch the School Sector Development Plan (SSDP) covering 2016-2023, replacing the earlier School Sector Reform Plan?
Nepali Question: नेपाल सरकारले सन् २०१६-२०२३ लाई समेट्ने विद्यालय क्षेत्र विकास योजना (SSDP) किन सुरु गर्‍यो, जसले अघिल्लो विद्यालय क्षेत्र सुधार योजनालाई प्रतिस्थापन गर्‍यो?
Gold Answer (EN): SSDP was designed to build on gains from the earlier School Sector Reform Plan by extending basic education through Grade 8 and secondary education through Grade 12, shift focus from access/enrollment toward quality and learning outcomes, reduce persistent equity gaps for disadvantaged groups and children with disabilities, and align the education system with Nepal's new federal structure following the 2015 Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): SSDP लाई अघिल्लो विद्यालय क्षेत्र सुधार योजनाबाट प्राप्त उपलब्धिलाई थप सुदृढ र विस्तार गर्न, आधारभूत शिक्षालाई कक्षा ८ सम्म र माध्यमिक शिक्षालाई कक्षा १२ सम्म विस्तार गर्न, (पहुँच/भर्नामात्र नभई) शिक्षाको गुणस्तर र सिकाइ उपलब्धि सुधार गर्न, विपन्न वर्ग र अपाङ्गता भएका विद्यार्थीबीचको रहिरहेको असमानता घटाउन, र सन् २०१५ को संविधानपछि नेपालको नयाँ संघीय संरचनासँग शिक्षा प्रणालीलाई मिलाउनका लागि ल्याइएको थियो।
Explanation: Causal/policy synthesis question — a 'why' question is a strong hallucination probe since models may invent specific mechanisms, numbers, or dates. Not cross-checked against the official SSDP core document; flagged for verification.
Source Title: General reference on Nepal's School Sector Development Plan

English Question: Nepal's first satellite, NepaliSat-1, was launched in April 2019. Who were the two Nepali scientists who developed it, and where were they studying at the time?
Nepali Question: नेपालको पहिलो उपग्रह, नेपालीस्याट-१, सन् २०१९ अप्रिलमा प्रक्षेपण गरिएको थियो। यसलाई विकास गर्ने दुई नेपाली वैज्ञानिक को थिए, र त्यसबेला उनीहरू कहाँ अध्ययनरत थिए?
Gold Answer (EN): Aabhas Maskey and Hariram Shrestha, both Nepali scientists who were studying at Japan's Kyushu Institute of Technology (Kyutech) at the time, developed NepaliSat-1 under the Nepal Academy of Science and Technology's (NAST) sponsorship.
Gold Answer (NE): आभास मास्के र हरिराम श्रेष्ठ — दुबै नेपाली वैज्ञानिक, जो त्यसबेला जापानको क्युशु प्रविधि संस्थान (Kyutech) मा अध्ययनरत थिए — ले नेपाल विज्ञान तथा प्रविधि प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठान (NAST) को सहयोगमा नेपालीस्याट-१ विकास गरेका थिए।
Explanation: Verified via web search, July 2026.
Source Title: NepaliSat-1 mission and developer details

English Question: What specific scientific instruments/payload did NepaliSat-1 carry, and what was each intended to measure or capture?
Nepali Question: नेपालीस्याट-१ मा कुन विशेष वैज्ञानिक उपकरण/पेलोड राखिएको थियो, र प्रत्येकले के मापन वा खिच्ने उद्देश्य राखेको थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): It carried a five-megapixel camera to capture images of Nepal's topography (mountains, hills, Terai, glaciers, roads) and a magnetometer to collect data on the Earth's magnetic field.

Explanation: Verified via web search (Kathmandu Post), July 2026.

English Question: On what exact date and local Nepal time was NepaliSat-1 launched, and from which facility?
Nepali Question: नेपालीस्याट-१ ठ्याक्कै कुन मिति र नेपाली स्थानीय समयमा प्रक्षेपण गरिएको थियो, र कुन प्रक्षेपण स्थलबाट?
Gold Answer (EN): It was launched at 2:31 am Nepal time on 18 April 2019 (Baishakh 5, 2076 BS) — 17 April 2019 US time — aboard a Cygnus NG-11 cargo mission on an Antares 230 rocket from NASA's Wallops Flight Facility in Virginia, USA.
Gold Answer (NE): यो नेपाली समयअनुसार १८ अप्रिल २०१९ (२०७६ साल बैशाख ५ गते) बिहान २:३१ बजे — अमेरिकी समयअनुसार १७ अप्रिल २०१९ — मा अमेरिकाको भर्जिनियास्थित नासाको वालप्स फ्लाइट फेसिलिटीबाट एन्टारेस २३० रकेटमार्फत साइग्नस एनजी-११ कार्गो मिसनमार्फत प्रक्षेपण गरिएको थियो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: date/timezone confusion — the Nepal-local date and US-local date differ by a calendar day — plus multiple precise numbers (time, rocket, BS date) that models often get partially wrong. Verified via web search, July 2026.
Source Title: NepaliSat-1 mission and developer details

English Question: The 2015 Gorkha earthquake sequence's largest aftershock (magnitude 7.3) struck on 12 May 2015. Where exactly was its epicenter located?
Nepali Question: सन् २०१५ को गोरखा भूकम्प शृंखलाको सबैभन्दा ठूलो पराकम्प (म्याग्निच्युड ७.३) १२ मे २०१५ मा गएको थियो। यसको केन्द्रबिन्दु ठ्याक्कै कहाँ थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): Along the Dolakha-Sindhupalchok district border near Kodari, roughly 76-83 km east-northeast of Kathmandu (close to the Everest region), at a depth of about 15-18.5 km.
Gold Answer (NE): डोलखा र सिन्धुपाल्चोक जिल्लाको सीमामा, कोदारी नजिक, काठमाडौंबाट अनुमानित ७६-८३ किमी पूर्व-उत्तरपूर्वमा (एभरेस्ट क्षेत्रको नजिक), करिब १५-१८.५ किमी गहिराइमा।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: easy to confuse with the main shock's epicenter (Barpak, Gorkha district, ~80 km NW of Kathmandu) — this aftershock struck in the opposite direction (ENE, near Everest). Verified via web search, July 2026.
Source Title: May 2015 Nepal earthquake (largest aftershock) details

English Question: Why is the Kathmandu Valley considered to be at exceptionally high seismic risk compared to other Himalayan towns of similar size, beyond simply being close to active faults?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौं उपत्यकालाई सक्रिय भ्रंशहरूको नजिक भएकै कारणभन्दा बाहेक, किन उस्तै आकारका अन्य हिमाली सहरहरूको तुलनामा असाधारण रूपमा उच्च भूकम्पीय जोखिममा रहेको मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Because the valley sits atop several hundred metres of soft, water-saturated ancient lake-bed sediment (from the former Kathmandu paleo-lake), which amplifies and prolongs seismic shaking far more than solid bedrock would. Combined with this basin-amplification effect, the valley also has very high population density and a large stock of older, unreinforced masonry buildings, all of which compound the risk.
Gold Answer (NE): किनभने उपत्यका पुरानो काठमाडौं ताल (paleo-lake) बाट बनेको नरम, पानीले भिजेको ताल-तल्छट (sediment) को केही सय मिटर तहमाथि अवस्थित छ, जसले ठोस चट्टानको तुलनामा भूकम्पीय हल्लाइलाई धेरै बढाउँछ र लम्ब्याउँछ; यो 'बेसिन एम्प्लिफिकेसन' प्रभावसँगै उपत्यकामा अत्यधिक जनघनत्व र धेरै पुराना, बिना-सुदृढीकरण गरिएका ईंटा/माटोका घरहरू पनि रहेकाले जोखिम अझ बढ्छ।
Explanation: Causal/reasoning question combining known geology (basin amplification from lake sediments) with general risk factors — models may invent specific mechanisms or numbers. Flagged for verification against a primary seismological source.
Source Title: General reference on Kathmandu Valley seismic risk

English Question: Bir Hospital, Nepal's first modern hospital, was established in 1889. Who founded it, and what was his role at the time?
Nepali Question: बीर अस्पताल, नेपालको पहिलो आधुनिक अस्पताल, सन् १८८९ मा स्थापना भएको थियो। यसलाई कसले स्थापना गरेका थिए, र त्यसबेला उनको भूमिका के थियो?
