English Question: What specific epidemiological threshold does the WHO use to validate a country as having eliminated maternal and neonatal tetanus (MNT), and what did Nepal's most recent (2025) reassessment conclude?
Nepali Question: WHO ले कुनै देशलाई मातृ तथा नवजात धनुष्टङ्कार (MNT) उन्मूलन भएको प्रमाणित गर्न कुन विशेष महामारीविज्ञान सीमा प्रयोग गर्छ, र नेपालको सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो (सन् २०२५) पुनर्मूल्यांकनले के निष्कर्ष निकाल्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): WHO validates MNT elimination when a country sustains fewer than one case of neonatal tetanus per 1,000 live births in every single district. Nepal's 2025 reassessment (by WHO headquarters, WHO SEARO, WHO Nepal, and UNICEF) reconfirmed that Nepal continues to sustain this elimination status, first achieved in 2005.
Gold Answer (NE): WHO ले कुनै देशले प्रत्येक जिल्लामा प्रति १,००० जीवित जन्ममा नवजात धनुष्टङ्कारको १ भन्दा कम केस कायम राखेको खण्डमा MNT उन्मूलन प्रमाणित गर्छ। नेपालको सन् २०२५ को पुनर्मूल्यांकनले (WHO मुख्यालय, WHO SEARO, WHO नेपाल र युनिसेफद्वारा) सन् २००५ मा पहिलोपटक हासिल गरेको यो उन्मूलन स्थिति निरन्तर कायम रहेको पुष्टि गर्‍यो।
Explanation: Verified via web search, July 2026.
Source Title: WHO reconfirms Nepal's MNT-free status (2025)

English Question: In what year did Nepal first achieve WHO-validated elimination of maternal and neonatal tetanus (MNT), and what earlier national campaign made this possible?
Nepali Question: नेपालले मातृ तथा नवजात धनुष्टङ्कार (MNT) उन्मूलन WHO बाट पहिलोपटक कुन वर्ष प्रमाणित गराएको थियो, र यो सम्भव बनाउने अघिल्लो राष्ट्रिय अभियान के थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): 2005 — made possible by national supplemental tetanus toxoid (TT) immunization campaigns for women of reproductive age conducted between 2000 and 2004, which raised the proportion of newborns protected at birth against tetanus above 80%.
Gold Answer (NE): सन् २००५ — सन् २००० देखि २००४ सम्म प्रजनन उमेरका महिलाहरूका लागि सञ्चालित राष्ट्रिय पूरक धनुष्टङ्कार खोप (TT) अभियानले यो सम्भव बनायो, जसले जन्मँदाकै बेला धनुष्टङ्कारबाट सुरक्षित नवजात शिशुको अनुपात ८०% भन्दा माथि पुर्‍यायो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: easy to confuse with the 2016 WHO South-East Asia regional elimination announcement (about Indonesia completing the region, not Nepal) or the 2025 reconfirmation date. Verified via web search, July 2026.
Source Title: WHO reconfirms Nepal's MNT-free status (2025)

English Question: Where exactly is Nepal's National Public Health Laboratory (NPHL) — the country's central reference laboratory for disease surveillance — located, and when was it originally established, under what earlier name?
Nepali Question: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय जनस्वास्थ्य प्रयोगशाला (NPHL) — जुन देशको रोग निगरानीका लागि केन्द्रीय सन्दर्भ प्रयोगशाला हो — ठ्याक्कै कहाँ अवस्थित छ, र यो सुरुमा कुन नामबाट कहिले स्थापना भएको थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): It is located in Teku, Kathmandu. It was originally established in 1968 as the Central Health Laboratory, and was renamed the National Public Health Laboratory in 1991.
Gold Answer (NE): यो काठमाडौंको टेकुमा अवस्थित छ। यो सुरुमा सन् १९६८ मा केन्द्रीय स्वास्थ्य प्रयोगशाला (Central Health Laboratory) को नामबाट स्थापना भएको थियो, र सन् १९९१ मा यसको नाम राष्ट्रिय जनस्वास्थ्य प्रयोगशाला राखियो।
Explanation: Verified via web search, July 2026.
Source Title: National Public Health Laboratory (NPHL) history and location

English Question: Why does Nepal's maternal mortality ratio vary so substantially between provinces, with Karnali Province consistently reporting far higher rates than Bagmati Province?
Nepali Question: नेपालको मातृ मृत्युदर प्रदेशहरूबीच किन यति धेरै फरक हुन्छ, जहाँ कर्णाली प्रदेशले बाग्मती प्रदेशभन्दा निरन्तर धेरै उच्च दर देखाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): Largely because Karnali is Nepal's most remote and mountainous province, with the fewest roads, health facilities, and skilled birth attendants per capita. Long travel times to emergency obstetric care, lower rates of institutional delivery, higher poverty, and lower female literacy all combine to raise maternal mortality there relative to the more urbanized, better-connected Bagmati province (home to Kathmandu).
Gold Answer (NE): मुख्यतया किनभने कर्णाली नेपालको सबैभन्दा दुर्गम र पहाडी/हिमाली प्रदेश हो, जहाँ प्रतिव्यक्ति सडक, स्वास्थ्य संस्था र दक्ष प्रसूति सहायक सबैभन्दा कम छन्; आपत्कालीन प्रसूति सेवामा पुग्न लाग्ने लामो समय, संस्थागत प्रसूतिको न्यून दर, उच्च गरिबी र महिला साक्षरताको न्यून दरले काठमाडौं रहेको र बढी सहरीकृत बाग्मती प्रदेशको तुलनामा त्यहाँ मातृ मृत्युदर बढाउँछ।
Explanation: Causal/explanatory synthesis based on general public-health knowledge of provincial disparities, not sourced from a single verified statistical report. Exact province-to-province numeric comparison should be checked against the latest Nepal Demographic and Health Survey before treating as final; flagged for verification.
Source Title: General reference on Nepal's provincial maternal health disparities

English Question: How did Nepal's 2015 Constitution actually change who is responsible for running basic and secondary schools, compared to the old centralized system before federalism?
Nepali Question: नेपालको सन् २०१५ को संविधानले संघीयता अघिको केन्द्रीकृत प्रणालीको तुलनामा आधारभूत र माध्यमिक विद्यालयहरू सञ्चालनको जिम्मेवारी वास्तवमा कसरी परिवर्तन गर्‍यो?
Gold Answer (EN): Before 2015, Nepal's central Ministry of Education controlled nearly everything about school education — curriculum, budgets, and teacher management — directly from Kathmandu. The 2015 Constitution (Article 57 and Schedule 8) shifted management and regulation of basic and secondary education to Nepal's 753 newly created local governments (municipalities and rural municipalities), giving them authority over school infrastructure and budgets, while provinces took over provincial higher education and the federal level retained only federal universities. However, exactly which tier controls teacher hiring, transfer, and promotion has remained contested and only partially implemented, leading to repeated teacher protests over the unresolved School Education Bill.
Gold Answer (NE): सन् २०१५ अघि, नेपालको केन्द्रीय शिक्षा मन्त्रालयले विद्यालय शिक्षाका लगभग सबै पक्ष — पाठ्यक्रम, बजेट, र शिक्षक व्यवस्थापन — काठमाडौंबाटै प्रत्यक्ष नियन्त्रण गर्थ्यो। सन् २०१५ को संविधान (धारा ५७ र अनुसूची ८) ले आधारभूत र माध्यमिक शिक्षाको व्यवस्थापन तथा नियमन नेपालका ७५३ वटा नयाँ स्थानीय तहलाई हस्तान्तरण गर्‍यो, जसले विद्यालय पूर्वाधार र बजेटको अधिकार पायो, जबकि प्रदेशहरूले प्रादेशिक उच्च शिक्षा र संघीय तहले मात्र संघीय विश्वविद्यालयहरूको जिम्मा लियो। तर शिक्षक भर्ना, सरुवा र बढुवाको अधिकार ठ्याक्कै कुन तहमा रहन्छ भन्ने विवादित नै रहेको छ र अझै पूर्ण रूपमा कार्यान्वयन भएको छैन, जसका कारण अनसुलझे विद्यालय शिक्षा विधेयकको विरोधमा शिक्षकहरूले पटक-पटक आन्दोलन गरेका छन्।
Explanation: Process/mechanism question about a multi-tier legal restructuring — models are likely to hallucinate which government tier controls teachers vs. curriculum vs. infrastructure, since the division of authority is genuinely contested even among Nepali stakeholders. Verified via web search, July 2026.
Source Title: Federal decentralization of school education in Nepal

English Question: How exactly was NepaliSat-1 deployed into orbit once it reached the International Space Station, and how long did it wait there first?
Nepali Question: नेपालीस्याट-१ अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय अन्तरिक्ष स्टेसनमा पुगेपछि यसलाई ठ्याक्कै कसरी कक्षमा प्रक्षेपण गरियो, र यसले त्यहाँ पहिले कति समय पर्खनुपर्‍यो?
Gold Answer (EN): After arriving at the ISS on 19 April 2019, NepaliSat-1 remained stored inside the station for about two months. On 17 June 2019, it was deployed into low Earth orbit from the Japanese Experiment Module 'Kibo', using the JEM Small Satellite Orbital Deployer (J-SSOD) — a mechanism that moves CubeSats from Kibo's airlock into space and releases them, in this case alongside three other nations' satellites (from Japan, Sri Lanka, and Singapore) in the same batch.
Gold Answer (NE): अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय अन्तरिक्ष स्टेसनमा १९ अप्रिल २०१९ मा पुगेपछि, नेपालीस्याट-१ लगभग दुई महिना स्टेसनभित्रै भण्डारण गरिएको थियो। १७ जुन २०१९ मा, यसलाई जापानी प्रयोग मोड्युल 'किबो' बाट जे-एसएसओडी (JEM Small Satellite Orbital Deployer) प्रयोग गरी न्यून-पृथ्वी कक्षमा प्रक्षेपण गरियो — यो संयन्त्रले क्युबस्याटहरूलाई किबोको एयरलकबाट अन्तरिक्षमा सारेर छोड्छ, र यस पटक जापान, श्रीलंका र सिंगापुरका अन्य तीन देशका उपग्रहहरूसँगै उही ब्याचमा प्रक्षेपण गरिएको थियो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: easy to conflate the launch date (17-18 April 2019, from Earth) with the later, separate deployment date (17 June 2019, from the ISS into orbit) — two distinct events two months apart. Verified via web search (JAXA), July 2026.
Source Title: JAXA record of NepaliSat-1 deployment from Kibo module

English Question: How does Nepal's Female Community Health Volunteer (FCHV) program actually work at the village level, and how has it contributed to reducing maternal mortality?
Nepali Question: नेपालको महिला स्वास्थ्य स्वयंसेविका (FCHV) कार्यक्रम गाउँ तहमा वास्तवमा कसरी काम गर्छ, र यसले मातृ मृत्युदर घटाउनमा कसरी योगदान गरेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Launched in 1988/89, the program places at least one trained female volunteer in every ward, selected locally by mothers' groups and serving without salary. After roughly 18 days of government training covering maternal health, newborn care, family planning, and nutrition counselling, FCHVs go door-to-door promoting antenatal care, distributing family-planning supplies, referring high-risk pregnancies to health facilities, and reporting community health data upward to the formal health system. With over 50,000 FCHVs now active nationwide, the program is widely credited as a major contributor to Nepal's maternal mortality ratio falling by roughly 80%, from about 850 to about 170 deaths per 100,000 live births between 1991 and 2011.
Gold Answer (NE): सन् १९८८/८९ मा सुरु भएको यो कार्यक्रमले हरेक वडामा कम्तिमा एक प्रशिक्षित महिला स्वयंसेविका राख्छ, जसलाई स्थानीय आमा समूहले छनोट गर्छ र उनी तलबविना सेवा गर्छिन्। सरकारी तालिम (मातृ स्वास्थ्य, नवजात शिशु स्याहार, परिवार नियोजन र पोषण परामर्श समेटेर लगभग १८ दिनको) पछि, FCHV हरूले घर-घर गएर गर्भावस्था जाँच प्रवर्द्धन गर्छन्, परिवार नियोजनका सामग्री वितरण गर्छन्, उच्च जोखिमयुक्त गर्भावस्थालाई स्वास्थ्य संस्थामा रिफर गर्छन्, र सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य तथ्याङ्क औपचारिक स्वास्थ्य प्रणालीलाई बुझाउँछन्। हाल देशभर ५०,००० भन्दा बढी FCHV सक्रिय रहेकाले, यो कार्यक्रमलाई नेपालको मातृ मृत्युदर सन् १९९१ देखि २०११ को बीचमा प्रति १,००,००० जीवित जन्ममा करिब ८५० बाट करिब १७० सम्म — अर्थात् लगभग ८०% ले — घटाउनमा प्रमुख योगदानको श्रेय दिइन्छ।
Explanation: Process/mechanism question with several precise, easy-to-swap numbers (18 days training, 50,000 volunteers, 850→170 per 100,000, 1991-2011 window) — a strong hallucination probe. Verified via web search (BMC Health Services Research, DHS report), July 2026.
Source Title: FCHV program mechanism and maternal mortality impact

English Question: Many people in Nepal still call the Grade 10 final exam the "SLC." After the 2016 Education Act reform, which exam name now actually refers to the Grade 10 exam, and which name was reassigned to Grade 12 instead?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा धेरैले अझै पनि कक्षा १० को अन्तिम परीक्षालाई "एसएलसी" भन्ने गर्छन्। सन् २०१६ को शिक्षा ऐन संशोधनपछि, कुन परीक्षाको नामले अहिले वास्तवमा कक्षा १० को परीक्षालाई जनाउँछ, र कुन नाम बरु कक्षा १२ मा सारिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Since the reform took effect in 2017 (2074 BS), the Grade 10 final exam is officially called the Secondary Education Examination (SEE), while the old name SLC (School Leaving Certificate) was reassigned to the Grade 12 final exam — the reverse of what most people assume.
Gold Answer (NE): सन् २०१७ (२०७४ साल) मा लागू भएको संशोधनपछि, कक्षा १० को अन्तिम परीक्षालाई आधिकारिक रूपमा माध्यमिक शिक्षा परीक्षा (एसईई) भनिन्छ, जबकि पुरानो नाम एसएलसी (स्कुल लिभिङ सर्टिफिकेट) कक्षा १२ को अन्तिम परीक्षामा सारिएको छ — यो धेरैले सोचेको भन्दा उल्टो हो।
Explanation: Classic name-swap trap: the Education Act reform (effective 2017/2073-74 BS) renamed the Grade 10 exam to SEE and reassigned "SLC" to Grade 12, but many people still use the pre-2016 naming out of habit.
Source Title: School Leaving Certificate (Nepal) — SLC/SEE reform history

English Question: Before December 2020, Nepal officially recognized one height for Mount Everest, based on a 1950s Survey of India measurement. After Nepal and China jointly announced a new measurement in December 2020, by how much did the official height increase, and what is the new figure?
Nepali Question: डिसेम्बर २०२० अघि, नेपालले १९५० को दशकको भारतीय सर्वेक्षण (Survey of India) मा आधारित सगरमाथाको एउटै उचाइलाई आधिकारिक रूपमा मान्थ्यो। डिसेम्बर २०२० मा नेपाल र चीनले संयुक्त रूपमा नयाँ मापन घोषणा गरेपछि, आधिकारिक उचाइ कतिले बढ्यो, र नयाँ अंक कति हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Nepal's earlier officially recognized height was 8,848 metres (29,028 ft), based on a 1950s Survey of India measurement. The new joint 2020 measurement raised it by about 0.86 metres (86 cm) to 8,848.86 metres (29,031.69 ft).
Gold Answer (NE): नेपालको अघिल्लो आधिकारिक उचाइ ८,८४८ मिटर (२९,०२८ फिट) थियो, जुन १९५० को दशकको भारतीय सर्वेक्षणमा आधारित थियो। सन् २०२० को नयाँ संयुक्त मापनले यसलाई करिब ०.८६ मिटर (८६ सेन्टिमिटर) बढाएर ८,८४८.८६ मिटर (२९,०३१.६९ फिट) पुर्‍यायो।
Explanation: Models often either keep repeating the old 8,848 m figure as still current, or overstate the size of the 2020 increase (it was less than 1 metre, not several metres).
Source Title: Nepal-China joint announcement of Mount Everest's new height (2020)

English Question: Just before the 2020 joint announcement, Nepal's and China's officially recognized heights for Everest did not match each other. Which country's figure was lower, and what technical difference in what was being measured explains the roughly 4-metre gap?
Nepali Question: सन् २०२० को संयुक्त घोषणा हुनुअघि, सगरमाथाको लागि नेपाल र चीनले आधिकारिक मान्ने उचाइ एकआपसमा मिल्दैनथ्यो। कुन देशको अंक कम थियो, र करिब ४ मिटरको फरकलाई कुन प्राविधिक भिन्नताले व्याख्या गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): China's pre-2020 official figure (around 8,844 metres) was the lower one — about 4 metres less than Nepal's 8,848-metre figure — because China measured only the exposed rock at the summit, excluding the snow and ice cap, while Nepal's figure included the snow cap.
Gold Answer (NE): चीनको सन् २०२० अघिको आधिकारिक अंक (करिब ८,८४४ मिटर) कम थियो — नेपालको ८,८४८ मिटरको अंकभन्दा करिब ४ मिटर कम — किनभने चीनले हिउँ र बरफको तह नछोडी केवल चट्टानी शिखर मात्र नाप्यो, जबकि नेपालको अंकमा हिउँको तह समावेश थियो।
Explanation: Trap: it's tempting to assume the rock-only measurement would be the higher, more 'solid' figure, but excluding the snow cap actually made China's number the smaller one.
Source Title: Mt Everest: Nepal, China announce revised height at 8,849 metres

English Question: Nepal's devastating "Gorkha earthquake" struck on 25 April 2015 with its epicenter in Gorkha district. Less than three weeks later, a second major earthquake — often mistaken for just an aftershock — struck Nepal again. On what date did it occur, what was its magnitude, and in which district(s) was its epicenter (not Gorkha)?
Nepali Question: नेपालको विनाशकारी "गोर्खा भूकम्प" सन् २०१५ अप्रिल २५ मा गोर्खा जिल्लामा केन्द्रविन्दु भएर गएको थियो। त्यसको तीन हप्ता नपुग्दै, प्रायः पराकम्प मात्र ठानिने अर्को ठूलो भूकम्प नेपालमा पुनः गयो। यो कुन मितिमा गयो, यसको म्याग्निच्युड कति थियो, र यसको केन्द्रविन्दु कुन जिल्ला(हरू) मा थियो (गोर्खा होइन)?
Gold Answer (EN): The second major earthquake struck on 12 May 2015, with a moment magnitude of about 7.2–7.3. Its epicenter was near the border of Dolakha and Sindhupalchowk districts, roughly 18 km southeast of Kodari — not in Gorkha district, where the original 25 April quake was centered.
Gold Answer (NE): दोस्रो ठूलो भूकम्प सन् २०१५ मे १२ मा गएको थियो, जसको मोमेन्ट म्याग्निच्युड करिब ७.२–७.३ थियो। यसको केन्द्रविन्दु डोलखा र सिन्धुपाल्चोक जिल्लाको सीमानाजिक, कोदारीबाट करिब १८ किमी दक्षिण-पूर्वमा थियो — गोर्खा जिल्लामा होइन, जहाँ अप्रिल २५ को मूल भूकम्पको केन्द्रविन्दु थियो।
Explanation: Easy to hallucinate a Gorkha epicenter for both events, or to dismiss the 12 May event as a minor aftershock rather than a major, separately significant earthquake.
Source Title: April 2015 and May 2015 Nepal earthquakes

English Question: Two different Nepali women named "Pasang Lhamu Sherpa" are both linked to Mount Everest, 14 years apart. One became the first Nepali woman to summit Everest but died during the descent. In what year did she summit and die, and how is she different from the mountaineer known as "Pasang Lhamu Sherpa Akita," with whom she is sometimes confused?
Nepali Question: "पासाङ ल्हामु शेर्पा" नाम गरेका दुई फरक नेपाली महिला सगरमाथासँग जोडिएका छन्, १४ वर्षको फरकमा। एउटी सगरमाथा चढ्ने पहिलो नेपाली महिला बनिन् तर ओर्लंदा मृत्यु भयो। उनी कुन वर्ष चढेर मृत्यु भइन्, र कहिलेकाहीँ उनीसँग भ्रमित हुने पर्वतारोही "पासाङ ल्हामु शेर्पा अकिता"भन्दा उनी कसरी फरक छिन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The original Pasang Lhamu Sherpa summited Everest and died during the descent on 22 April 1993, becoming the first Nepali woman to reach the top. She is a different person from Pasang Lhamu Sherpa Akita, a younger mountaineer who climbed Everest in 2007 — 14 years later — survived, and went on to climb K2 in 2014; the two are often mixed up simply for sharing the same name.
Gold Answer (NE): मूल पासाङ ल्हामु शेर्पाले सगरमाथा आरोहण गरी १९९३ अप्रिल २२ मा ओर्लंदा मृत्यु भइन्, र सगरमाथा टुप्पोमा पुग्ने पहिलो नेपाली महिला बनिन्। उनी पासाङ ल्हामु शेर्पा अकिताभन्दा फरक व्यक्ति हुन्, जो १४ वर्षपछि सन् २००७ मा सगरमाथा चढेकी कान्छी पर्वतारोही हुन्, बाँचिन्, र सन् २०१४ मा के२ समेत आरोहण गरिन्; उस्तै नामका कारण यी दुई प्रायः भ्रमित हुने गर्छन्।
Explanation: Shared name across two real, unrelated mountaineers is a strong hallucination trigger; models often merge their biographies or misattribute achievements and dates.
Source Title: Pasang Lhamu Sherpa and Pasang Lhamu Sherpa Akita

English Question: Nepal recorded South Asia's first confirmed COVID-19 case, but the patient had already returned from Wuhan and even been discharged from isolation before his test came back positive. On what date was the case officially confirmed, and roughly how many days after his return from Wuhan was that?
Nepali Question: नेपालले दक्षिण एसियाको पहिलो पुष्टि भएको कोभिड-१९ केस दर्ता गर्‍यो, तर बिरामी वुहानबाट फर्किसकेका र परीक्षण नतिजा पोजिटिभ आउनुअघि नै आइसोलेसनबाट डिस्चार्ज भइसकेका थिए। यो केस आधिकारिक रूपमा कुन मितिमा पुष्टि भयो, र वुहानबाट फर्किएको करिब कति दिनपछि यस्तो भयो?
Gold Answer (EN): Nepal's first COVID-19 case was officially confirmed on 23 January 2020 — a 32-year-old man who had returned from Wuhan on 9 January 2020, so confirmation came roughly two weeks (about 14 days) after his return; he had already been discharged from hospital observation by the time the positive result came back.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपालको पहिलो कोभिड-१९ केस आधिकारिक रूपमा सन् २०२० जनवरी २३ मा पुष्टि भयो — ३२ वर्षीय पुरुष जो सन् २०२० जनवरी ९ मा वुहानबाट फर्किएका थिए, त्यसैले पुष्टि हुँदा उनको फर्किएको करिब दुई हप्ता (करिब १४ दिन) भइसकेको थियो; नतिजा आउँदा उनी अस्पतालको अवलोकनबाट डिस्चार्ज भइसकेका थिए।
Explanation: Trap layers stack here: the exact confirmation date, the length of the gap since return, and the detail that he'd already been discharged before the result was known — details a model might smooth over or invent.
Source Title: COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal — first case timeline

English Question: Nepal's 2021 census reported male and female literacy rates (population aged 5 and above) that differ by a wide margin. Which gender has the higher rate, and roughly how many percentage points separate the two figures?
Nepali Question: नेपालको सन् २०२१ को जनगणनाले ५ वर्ष र माथिका जनसंख्याको पुरुष र महिला साक्षरता दर फरक-फरक देखाएको छ। कुन लिङ्गको दर बढी छ, र दुई अंकबीच करिब कति प्रतिशत बिन्दुको फरक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Male literacy (about 83.6%) is higher than female literacy (about 69.4%), a gap of roughly 14 percentage points — even though the combined overall literacy rate is often quoted as around 76%, which can mask how wide the gender gap actually is.
Gold Answer (NE): पुरुष साक्षरता दर (करिब ८३.६%) महिला साक्षरता दर (करिब ६९.४%) भन्दा बढी छ, जुन करिब १४ प्रतिशत बिन्दुको फरक हो — यद्यपि समग्र साक्षरता दर प्रायः करिब ७६% भनी उल्लेख गरिन्छ, जसले लैंगिक खाडल कति ठूलो छ भन्ने कुरा लुकाउन सक्छ।
Explanation: Models often quote only the combined national literacy rate and fail to reproduce (or invert) the actual size of the male-female gap.
Source Title: Nepal 2021 Census — literacy rate by gender

English Question: Nepal's Constitution (Article 31) does not guarantee the same thing at every grade level — one level is both "compulsory AND free," while a higher level is only "free" but not compulsory. Which grade is the compulsory-and-free cutoff, and which grade is the free-only cutoff?
Nepali Question: नेपालको संविधान (धारा ३१) ले हरेक कक्षा तहमा एउटै कुराग्यारेन्टी गर्दैन — एउटा तह "अनिवार्य र निःशुल्क" दुवै छ, जबकि माथिल्लो तह केवल "निःशुल्क" मात्र छ, अनिवार्य होइन। कुन कक्षा अनिवार्य-र-निःशुल्कको सीमा हो, र कुन कक्षा निःशुल्क-मात्रको सीमा हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Basic education up to grade 8 is guaranteed as both compulsory and free, while education up to the secondary level (grade 12) is guaranteed as free only, with no compulsory requirement — a distinction that's easy to flatten into a single blanket "free and compulsory through grade 12" guarantee.
Gold Answer (NE): आधारभूत शिक्षा (कक्षा ८ सम्म) अनिवार्य र निःशुल्क दुवै ग्यारेन्टी गरिएको छ, जबकि माध्यमिक तह (कक्षा १२ सम्म) सम्मको शिक्षा निःशुल्क मात्र ग्यारेन्टी गरिएको छ, अनिवार्य होइन — यो भिन्नतालाई प्रायः एउटै "कक्षा १२ सम्म निःशुल्क र अनिवार्य" भनी सरलीकरण गरिन्छ।
Explanation: Models often flatten this two-tier guarantee into a single blanket statement, losing the compulsory-vs-free-only distinction between grade 8 and grade 12.
Source Title: Constitution of Nepal, Article 31 — Right to Education

English Question: Nepal's 2015 Constitution created seven provinces but left them numbered rather than named. Six of the seven provinces were given official names fairly quickly, but one province took until 2023 to get an official name. Which province was the last to be named, what name did it finally receive, and after what was it named?
Nepali Question: नेपालको सन् २०१५ को संविधानले सात प्रदेश बनायो तर तिनलाई नामाकरण नगरी नम्बर मात्र दियो। सात मध्ये छ प्रदेशले चाँडै आधिकारिक नाम पाए, तर एउटा प्रदेशले सन् २०२३ सम्म कुनै आधिकारिक नाम पाएको थिएन। कुन प्रदेश सबैभन्दा पछि नामाकरण भयो, अन्ततः कुन नाम पायो, र केको नाममा राखियो?
Gold Answer (EN): Province No. 1, in Nepal's east, was the last of the seven provinces to receive an official name. Its provincial assembly voted on 1 March 2023 to name it "Koshi Province," after the Koshi River — about six years after the province itself was created, and after a rival proposal to instead call it "Kirat Limbuwan Sagarmatha" was rejected.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपालको पूर्वको प्रदेश नं. १ सात मध्ये सबैभन्दा पछि आधिकारिक नाम पाउने प्रदेश थियो। यसको प्रदेशसभाले सन् २०२३ मार्च १ मा यसलाई कोशी नदीको नाममा "कोशी प्रदेश" नामाकरण गर्ने निर्णय गर्‍यो — प्रदेश स्थापना भएको करिब छ वर्षपछि, र "किरात लिम्बुवान सगरमाथा" राख्ने विकल्प प्रस्ताव अस्वीकृत भएपछि।
Explanation: Models often assume all seven provinces were named simultaneously in 2015 along with the Constitution, or misidentify which province was the long holdout.
Source Title: Koshi: Province 1 finally becomes the last province to get its name

English Question: What is the difference between the year-on-year (YoY) Consumer Price Index (CPI) for the food and beverage group in the third quarter of 2080/81 and the YoY CPI for the "Non-food and Services" group in the same period?
Nepali Question: आर्थिक वर्ष २०८०/८१ को तेस्रो त्रैमासिकमा "खाद्य तथा पेय पदार्थ" समूह र "गैर-खाद्य तथा सेवा" समूहको वार्षिक (YoY) उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक (CPI) बीच के भिन्नता छ? यसले शिक्षाको वास्तविक लागत तथा शैक्षिक सामग्रीमा हुने घरायसी खर्चमा प्रभाव पार्छ।
Gold Answer (EN): 1.10 percentage points (Food & Beverage YoY CPI: 5.04%; Non-food and Services YoY CPI: 3.94%)
Gold Answer (NE): १.१० प्रतिशत विन्दु (खाद्य तथा पेय पदार्थ: ५.०४%, गैर-खाद्य: ४.९५%)
Explanation: The YoY CPI for the food and beverage group is 5.04%, and for the non-food and services group, it is 3.94%. The difference is 1.10 percentage points. You must ignore the overall inflation (2.72%) and extract the correct sub-group data
Source Title: Nepal Macroeconomic & Financial Stability Report (Q3 2080/81)

English Question: In the third quarter of 2080/81, total exports were Rs. 62.32 billion. If exports to India constituted approximately 70% of this, what is the approximate value of exports to India? If the total exports in the same period of the previous fiscal year were Rs. 51.70 billion, what is the percentage increase in total exports? This affects the education sector's ability to import books, IT equipment, and other learning materials, as well as the government's revenue for funding education.
Nepali Question: आर्थिक वर्ष २०८०/८१ को तेस्रो त्रैमासिकमा कुल निर्यात रु. ६२.३२ अर्ब रहेको थियो। यदि यसको लगभग ७०% भारततर्फको निर्यात रहेको मानिने हो भने, भारततर्फको निर्यातको अनुमानित मूल्य कति हुन्छ? यदि अघिल्लो आर्थिक वर्षको उही अवधिमा कुल निर्यात रु. ५१.७० अर्ब रहेको थियो भने, कुल निर्यातमा प्रतिशत वृद्धि कति भयो? यसले शिक्षा क्षेत्रका लागि पुस्तक, आईटी उपकरण, र अन्य शैक्षिक सामग्री आयात गर्ने क्षमता तथा शिक्षामा लगानी गर्ने सरकारी राजस्वलाई पनि असर गर्छ।
Gold Answer (EN): India-bound exports were approximately Rs. 43.62 billion (70% of Rs. 62.32 billion). Total exports increased by approximately 20.5% year-on-year, rising from Rs. 51.70 billion to Rs. 62.32 billion (an increase of Rs. 10.62 billion).
Gold Answer (NE): भारततर्फको निर्यात लगभग रु. ४३.६२ अर्ब हुन्छ (रु. ६२.३२ अर्बको ७०%)। कुल निर्यातमा वार्षिक आधारमा लगभग २०.५% वृद्धि भयो, जुन रु. ५१.७० अर्बबाट बढेर रु. ६२.३२ अर्ब पुग्यो (रु. १०.६२ अर्बको वृद्धि)।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: two-step calculation chained together (percentage-of-a-total, then year-on-year percentage-change) using close, easily-transposed multi-digit figures (62.32 vs 51.70); models often round early, drop the Rs. 10.62 billion intermediate step, or misapply the 70% share to the wrong-year figure.
Source Title: Nepal Macroeconomic & Financial Stability Report (Q3 2080/81)

English Question: According to Nepal Rastra Bank's report based on eleven months' data of fiscal year 2082/83 (2025/26), in US dollar terms, by what percentage did remittance inflows increase in the review period, and what was the year-on-year growth rate of remittance inflows in the same eleven-month period of the previous fiscal year?
Nepali Question: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ (२०२५/२६) को एघार महिनाको तथ्याङ्कमा आधारित प्रतिवेदन अनुसार, अमेरिकी डलर सन्दर्भमा समीक्षा अवधिमा विप्रेषण (रेमिट्यान्स) आप्रवाह कति प्रतिशतले वृद्धि भयो, र अघिल्लो आर्थिक वर्षको सोही एघार महिने अवधिमा विप्रेषण आप्रवाहको वार्षिक वृद्धिदर कति थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): Remittance inflows increased 29.6% to USD 14.59 billion in the eleven months of 2082/83. In the same eleven-month period of the previous fiscal year (2081/82), such inflows had increased by 12.8%.
Gold Answer (NE): आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिनामा विप्रेषण आप्रवाह २९.६% ले बढेर अमेरिकी डलर १४.५९ अर्ब पुगेको छ। अघिल्लो आर्थिक वर्ष (२०८१/८२) को सोही एघार महिने अवधिमा यस्तो आप्रवाह १२.८% ले बढेको थियो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: two close year-on-year growth percentages (29.6% vs 12.8%) for the same indicator in consecutive years; models often swap the two figures or state only one without the comparison year.
Source Title: Nepal Rastra Bank - Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation, English (Based on Eleven Months' Data of 2025/26)

English Question: Per Nepal Rastra Bank's eleven-month report of fiscal year 2082/83, what was Nepal's net secondary income (net transfer) in Rs. billion during the review period, and what was the corresponding figure in the same eleven-month period of the previous fiscal year?
Nepali Question: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिने प्रतिवेदन अनुसार, समीक्षा अवधिमा नेपालको खुद द्वितीयक आय (खुद हस्तान्तरण) रु. अर्बमा कति रह्यो, र अघिल्लो आर्थिक वर्षको सोही एघार महिने अवधिमा सो अङ्क कति थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): Net secondary income (net transfer) reached Rs. 2321.07 billion in the eleven months of 2082/83, compared to Rs. 1669.51 billion in the same period of the previous fiscal year (2081/82).
Gold Answer (NE): आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिनामा खुद द्वितीयक आय (खुद हस्तान्तरण) रु. २३२१.०७ अर्ब पुगेको छ, जुन अघिल्लो आर्थिक वर्ष (२०८१/८२) को सोही अवधिमा रु. १६६९.५१ अर्ब थियो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: precise multi-digit billion-rupee figures for the same indicator across two fiscal years; easy to transpose digits (2321.07 vs 1669.51) or round to a nearby plausible number.
Source Title: Nepal Rastra Bank - Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation, English (Based on Eleven Months' Data of 2025/26)

English Question: In the eleven months of fiscal year 2082/83, how many Nepali workers received first-time approval for foreign employment, and how many received approval for renewed entry, according to Nepal Rastra Bank?
Nepali Question: आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिनामा कति नेपाली कामदारले वैदेशिक रोजगारीको लागि पहिलोपटक स्वीकृति पाए, र कतिले नवीकरण गरी पुन: प्रवेशको स्वीकृति पाए, नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकका अनुसार?
Gold Answer (EN): 367,211 workers received first-time approval for foreign employment, and 355,735 workers received approval for renewed entry, in the eleven months of 2082/83.
Gold Answer (NE): आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिनामा ३,६७,२११ कामदारले वैदेशिक रोजगारीको लागि पहिलोपटक स्वीकृति पाएका छन्, र ३,५५,७३५ कामदारले नवीकरण गरी पुन: प्रवेशको स्वीकृति पाएका छन्।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: two large, closely-valued six-digit figures (367,211 vs 355,735) for the same period; models often round both to the same approximate number or swap which category is larger.
Source Title: Nepal Rastra Bank - Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation, English (Based on Eleven Months' Data of 2025/26)

English Question: In the eleven months of fiscal year 2082/83, private sector credit extended by commercial banks, development banks, and finance companies each increased by what respective percentage, according to Nepal Rastra Bank?
Nepali Question: आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिनामा वाणिज्य बैंक, विकास बैंक, र वित्त कम्पनीहरूबाट प्रवाहित निजी क्षेत्र कर्जा क्रमशः कति-कति प्रतिशतले बढ्यो, नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकका अनुसार?
Gold Answer (EN): Private sector credit increased 6.3% from commercial banks, 5.6% from development banks, and 3.9% from finance companies in the eleven months of 2082/83.
Gold Answer (NE): आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिनामा निजी क्षेत्र कर्जा वाणिज्य बैंकबाट ६.३%, विकास बैंकबाट ५.६%, र वित्त कम्पनीबाट ३.९% ले वृद्धि भएको छ।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: three near-duplicate percentage figures (6.3%, 5.6%, 3.9%) each tied to a different institution type; models often merge them into one overall figure or misassign which institution had the highest/lowest growth.
Source Title: Nepal Rastra Bank - Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation, English (Based on Eleven Months' Data of 2025/26)

English Question: As of mid-June 2026 (per Nepal Rastra Bank's eleven-month 2082/83 report), what share of total outstanding BFI credit was secured against current-assets collateral, and what share was secured against land collateral?
Nepali Question: २०२६ जुन मध्य (मध्य-असारसम्म) सम्ममा (नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिने प्रतिवेदन अनुसार), बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्थाहरूको कुल बक्यौता कर्जामध्ये कति अंश चालु सम्पत्ति धितोमा र कति अंश जग्गा धितोमा सुरक्षित थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): 14.7% of total outstanding BFI credit was secured against current-assets collateral (such as agricultural and non-agricultural products), and 63.6% was secured against land collateral, as of mid-June 2026.
Gold Answer (NE): २०२६ जुन मध्यसम्ममा बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्थाहरूको कुल बक्यौता कर्जामध्ये १४.७% चालु सम्पत्ति (कृषि तथा गैर-कृषि उत्पादन जस्ता) धितोमा र ६३.६% जग्गा धितोमा सुरक्षित रहेको छ।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: two collateral-type shares (14.7% vs 63.6%) that sum to less than 100% (remaining collateral types omitted from the source excerpt); models often assume these two are complementary and force them to sum to 100%.
Source Title: Nepal Rastra Bank - Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation, English (Based on Eleven Months' Data of 2025/26)

English Question: Nepal's maternal mortality ratio (MMR) has been reported at several different figures depending on the source and survey year — 539, 281, 239, 151, and 142 deaths per 100,000 live births. Which figure corresponds to which milestone: the 1996 NDHS estimate, the 2006 NDHS estimate, the 2016 figure for which Nepal received a Millennium Development Goals award, the 2021 National Statistics Office estimate, and the most recent UN/WHO estimate reported around April 2025?
Nepali Question: नेपालको मातृ मृत्युदर (एमएमआर) स्रोत र सर्वेक्षण वर्ष अनुसार फरक-फरक अङ्कमा प्रतिवेदित भएको छ — प्रति १,००,००० जीवित जन्ममा ५३९, २८१, २३९, १५१, र १४२ मृत्यु। कुन अङ्क कुन सन्दर्भसँग मेल खान्छ: सन् १९९६ को एनडीएचएस अनुमान, सन् २००६ को एनडीएचएस अनुमान, सन् २०१६ को अङ्क (जसका लागि नेपालले सहस्राब्दी विकास लक्ष्य पुरस्कार पायो), सन् २०२१ को राष्ट्रिय तथ्याङ्क कार्यालयको अनुमान, र सन् २०२५ अप्रिलतिर प्रतिवेदित नवीनतम संयुक्त राष्ट्र/विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठनको अनुमान?
Gold Answer (EN): 539 = 1996 NDHS estimate; 281 = 2006 NDHS estimate; 239 = the 2016 figure (down from 539 in 1996) for which Nepal received a Millennium Development Goals award; 151 = the 2021 National Statistics Office estimate; 142 = the most recent UN-IGME/WHO estimate, reported around April 2025.
Gold Answer (NE): ५३९ = सन् १९९६ को एनडीएचएस अनुमान; २८१ = सन् २००६ को एनडीएचएस अनुमान; २३९ = सन् २०१६ को अङ्क (१९९६ को ५३९ बाट घटेको), जसका लागि नेपालले सहस्राब्दी विकास लक्ष्य पुरस्कार पायो; १५१ = सन् २०२१ को राष्ट्रिय तथ्याङ्क कार्यालयको अनुमान; १४२ = सन् २०२५ अप्रिलतिर प्रतिवेदित नवीनतम संयुक्त राष्ट्र/विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठनको अनुमान।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: five near-duplicate MMR figures spanning three decades of surveys; models frequently mismatch a figure to the wrong year, invent a sixth figure, or collapse two distinct surveys (e.g., 1996 NDHS vs the 2021 NSO study) into one.
Source Title: Kathmandu Post - "Nepal has reduced maternal deaths by 70 percent since 2000, but the progress is at risk, WHO warns" (April 2025)
Source Type: News Media - flagged for verification (figures compiled across multiple surveys)

English Question: Two Nepali news reports published less than a year apart give opposite headline pictures of Nepal's institutional delivery rate trend — one (May 2025) says the rate "declined sharply", another (February 2026) says it rose to 90.5%. What rate did each report cite, and what explains the apparent contradiction?
Nepali Question: एक वर्षभन्दा कम अन्तरालमा प्रकाशित नेपालका दुई समाचार प्रतिवेदनले संस्थागत सुत्केरी दरको प्रवृत्तिबारे विपरीत चित्र देखाउँछन् — एउटा (मे २०२५) ले दर "तीव्र रूपमा घट्यो" भन्छ, अर्को (फेब्रुअरी २०२६) ले दर बढेर ९०.५% पुगेको भन्छ। प्रत्येक प्रतिवेदनले कुन दर उल्लेख गरेको छ, र यो देखिने विरोधाभासको कारण के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The May 2025 Kathmandu Post report, citing a National Statistics Office-linked study/UN health body figures, said the institutional delivery rate had declined alarmingly (around the roughly 80% level seen in 2022), while the February 2026 Kathmandu Post report, citing the Nepal Multiple Indicator Survey (NMIS) 2024-025 by the National Statistics Office and UNICEF, said institutional delivery rose to 90.5% by 2025 from around 80% in 2022. Health officials attributed the apparent contradiction to different survey methodologies and a declining total fertility rate affecting how delivery percentages are derived, rather than an actual reversal in service use.
Gold Answer (NE): मे २०२५ को काठमाडौं पोस्ट प्रतिवेदनले संस्थागत सुत्केरी दर चिन्ताजनक रूपमा घटेको (सन् २०२२ मा रहेको लगभग ८०% स्तरको हाराहारीमा) उल्लेख गरेको थियो, जबकि फेब्रुअरी २०२६ को काठमाडौं पोस्ट प्रतिवेदनले राष्ट्रिय तथ्याङ्क कार्यालय र युनिसेफद्वारा गरिएको नेपाल बहु-सूचक सर्वेक्षण (एनएमआईएस) २०२४-०२५ को हवाला दिँदै सन् २०२५ सम्ममा संस्थागत सुत्केरी दर सन् २०२२ को लगभग ८०%बाट बढेर ९०.५% पुगेको जनाएको थियो। स्वास्थ्य अधिकारीहरूका अनुसार यो विरोधाभास वास्तविक उल्टो प्रवृत्तिभन्दा पनि फरक-फरक सर्वेक्षण विधि र घट्दो कुल प्रजनन दरका कारण देखिएको हो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE (Why/synthesis): near-identical topic and timeframe with opposite headline conclusions; softer-verified synthesis question - treat as a reasonable reference answer rather than a strict key, per dataset convention for Why questions.
Source Title: Kathmandu Post - "Institutional delivery rate declines sharply" (May 2025) and "More mothers now deliver in hospitals, but deaths remain high" (Feb 2026)

English Question: According to Nepal's most recent health data reported in 2025, what is the neonatal mortality rate, the stillbirth rate, and the total fertility rate (TFR), and how does the neonatal mortality figure reported by WHO differ from the one separately cited by the Family Welfare Division of Nepal's Department of Health Services?
Nepali Question: सन् २०२५ मा प्रतिवेदित नेपालको नवीनतम स्वास्थ्य तथ्याङ्क अनुसार, नवजात मृत्युदर, मृतजन्म दर, र कुल प्रजनन दर (टीएफआर) कति हो, र विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठनले जनाएको नवजात मृत्युदर स्वास्थ्य सेवा विभागको पारिवारिक कल्याण महाशाखाले छुट्टै उल्लेख गरेको अङ्कभन्दा कसरी फरक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): WHO's 2025 report cites Nepal's neonatal mortality rate at 16.6 per 1,000 live births and stillbirth rate at 13.5 per 1,000 births, while Nepal's Family Welfare Division separately cited a neonatal mortality rate of 17 per 1,000 live births. The total fertility rate is estimated at about 1.76 in 2025, down from 1.94 in 2021.
Gold Answer (NE): विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठनको सन् २०२५ को प्रतिवेदनले नेपालको नवजात मृत्युदर प्रति १,००० जीवित जन्ममा १६.६ र मृतजन्म दर प्रति १,००० जन्ममा १३.५ रहेको जनाएको छ, जबकि स्वास्थ्य सेवा विभागको पारिवारिक कल्याण महाशाखाले छुट्टै रूपमा नवजात मृत्युदर प्रति १,००० जीवित जन्ममा १७ रहेको उल्लेख गरेको छ। कुल प्रजनन दर सन् २०२१ को १.९४ बाट घटेर सन् २०२५ मा लगभग १.७६ पुगेको अनुमान छ।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: near-duplicate neonatal mortality figures from two different bodies in the same year (16.6 vs 17 per 1,000) plus an adjacent stillbirth figure (13.5) and a declining TFR trend across two survey years — easy to conflate any two of the four numbers.
Source Title: Kathmandu Post - "Nepal has reduced maternal deaths by 70 percent since 2000, but the progress is at risk, WHO warns" (April 2025)

English Question: According to MoEST's Flash I Report 2081 (2024/25), what percentage and number of Early Childhood Education and Development (ECED) enrollees are from Dalit, Janajati, and Brahman/Chhetri-and-other communities respectively, and how did each of these percentages change from the previous year's report?
Nepali Question: शिक्षा, विज्ञान तथा प्रविधि मन्त्रालयको फ्ल्यास प्रतिवेदन २०८१ (२०२४/२५) अनुसार, प्रारम्भिक बाल विकास शिक्षा (ईसीईडी) मा भर्ना भएका बालबालिकामध्ये दलित, जनजाति, र ब्राह्मण/क्षेत्री-तथा-अन्य समुदायका बालबालिकाको प्रतिशत र संख्या क्रमशः कति छ, र अघिल्लो वर्षको प्रतिवेदनको तुलनामा प्रत्येक प्रतिशत कसरी परिवर्तन भयो?
Gold Answer (EN): 199,558 children (15.3%) enrolled in ECED are from Dalit communities, down from 16.2% the previous year; 426,189 (32.7%) are Janajati, down from 34.5%; and 675,678 (51.9%) are Brahman/Chhetri and other communities, up from 31.7% the previous year.
Gold Answer (NE): ईसीईडीमा भर्ना भएका बालबालिकामध्ये १,९९,५५८ (१५.३%) दलित समुदायका छन्, जुन अघिल्लो वर्षको १६.२%बाट घटेको हो; ४,२६,१८९ (३२.७%) जनजाति समुदायका छन्, जुन अघिल्लो वर्षको ३४.५%बाट घटेको हो; र ६,७५,६७८ (५१.९%) ब्राह्मण/क्षेत्री तथा अन्य समुदायका छन्, जुन अघिल्लो वर्षको ३१.७%बाट बढेको हो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: three ethnic/caste categories each with a current percentage AND a prior-year percentage (six numbers total) moving in different directions (two declining, one rising sharply); models often flatten this into a single static breakdown or invert the direction of change.
Source Title: Government of Nepal, MoEST - Flash I Report 2081 (2024/25)

English Question: Per the same Flash I Report 2081 (2024/25), out of the total government-supported ECED teachers, what share were female versus male, and what were the caste/ethnicity shares (Dalit, Janajati, Brahman/Chhetri and other) among those teachers?
Nepali Question: उही फ्ल्यास प्रतिवेदन २०८१ (२०२४/२५) अनुसार, सरकारी सहयोग प्राप्त कुल ईसीईडी शिक्षकमध्ये महिला र पुरुषको अंश कति छ, र ती शिक्षकहरूमा जात/जाति (दलित, जनजाति, ब्राह्मण/क्षेत्री तथा अन्य) को अंश कति छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Of 31,418 government-supported ECED teachers, 30,498 (97.1%) were female and 1,680 (2.9%) were male. By caste/ethnicity, 2,966 (6.4%) were Dalit, 11,377 (36.2%) were Janajati, and 18,017 (57.3%) were Brahman/Chhetri and other groups.
Gold Answer (NE): जम्मा ३१,४१८ सरकारी सहयोग प्राप्त ईसीईडी शिक्षकमध्ये ३०,४९८ (९७.१%) महिला र १,६८० (२.९%) पुरुष रहेका छन्। जात/जातिका आधारमा २,९६६ (६.४%) दलित, ११,३७७ (३६.२%) जनजाति, र १८,०१७ (५७.३%) ब्राह्मण/क्षेत्री तथा अन्य समूहका रहेका छन्।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: two separate demographic breakdowns (gender and caste/ethnicity) of the same teacher population, each with precise counts and percentages that must not be cross-mixed; models often merge the gender and caste figures into one confused set.
Source Title: Government of Nepal, MoEST - Flash I Report 2081 (2024/25)

English Question: On what exact date was the WHO South-East Asia Region certified polio-free, how many countries make up this WHO region, and what share of the world's population then came to live in WHO regions certified polio-free?
Nepali Question: विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठनको दक्षिण-पूर्व एसिया क्षेत्रलाई ठ्याक्कै कुन मितिमा पोलियोमुक्त प्रमाणित गरिएको थियो, यस क्षेत्रमा कति देश समावेश छन्, र यो प्रमाणीकरणपछि विश्वको कति प्रतिशत जनसंख्या पोलियोमुक्त प्रमाणित क्षेत्रहरूमा बस्न पुग्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): The WHO South-East Asia Region was certified polio-free on 27 March 2014. The region comprises 11 countries (Bangladesh, Bhutan, Democratic People's Republic of Korea, India, Indonesia, Maldives, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand, and Timor-Leste). With this certification, 80% of the world's population came to live in WHO regions certified polio-free.
Gold Answer (NE): विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठनको दक्षिण-पूर्व एसिया क्षेत्रलाई सन् २०१४ मार्च २७ मा पोलियोमुक्त प्रमाणित गरिएको थियो। यस क्षेत्रमा ११ देश (बंगलादेश, भुटान, उत्तर कोरिया, भारत, इन्डोनेसिया, माल्दिभ्स, म्यानमार, नेपाल, श्रीलंका, थाइल्यान्ड, र टिमोर-लेस्टे) समावेश छन्। यस प्रमाणीकरणसँगै विश्वको ८०% जनसंख्या पोलियोमुक्त प्रमाणित क्षेत्रहरूमा बस्न पुग्यो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: exact certification date plus two easily-confused numbers (11 member countries vs 80% of world population); models often swap the two percentages/counts or misremember the year as 2011 or 2020 (when other regions/milestones were in the news).
Source Title: WHO South-East Asia Region - Polio-free certification of the World Health Organization South-East Asia Region

English Question: Nepal released its first-ever consolidated national snow leopard population estimate in April 2025. What was the estimated population and density, and how does Nepal's snow leopard population rank among Asia's range countries compared to China, Mongolia, India, and Bhutan?
Nepali Question: नेपालले सन् २०२५ अप्रिलमा हिउँचितुवाको पहिलो एकीकृत राष्ट्रिय जनसंख्या अनुमान सार्वजनिक गर्‍यो। अनुमानित जनसंख्या र घनत्व कति थियो, र चीन, मंगोलिया, भारत, र भुटानको तुलनामा एसियाका हिउँचितुवा बासस्थान भएका देशहरूमध्ये नेपालको स्थान कहाँ पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Nepal's first national estimate placed its snow leopard population at 397 individuals, with a mean density of 1.56 individuals per 100 square kilometres. By country ranking, China has the largest population (about 2,000-2,500), followed by Mongolia (953), India (718), Nepal (397), and Bhutan (134) - making Nepal the fourth largest snow leopard population among these range countries despite holding only about 2% of the species' global habitat.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपालको पहिलो राष्ट्रिय अनुमानले हिउँचितुवाको जनसंख्या ३९७ रहेको देखाएको छ, जसको औसत घनत्व प्रति १०० वर्ग किलोमिटरमा १.५६ रहेको छ। देशगत क्रमअनुसार चीनमा सबैभन्दा बढी (लगभग २,०००-२,५००), त्यसपछि मंगोलिया (९५३), भारत (७१८), नेपाल (३९७), र भुटान (१३४) रहेका छन् - अर्थात् विश्वको जम्मा हिउँचितुवा बासस्थानको लगभग २% मात्र भएपनि नेपाल यी देशहरूमध्ये चौथो ठूलो जनसंख्या भएको देश हो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: five near-sequential country figures (2000-2500, 953, 718, 397, 134) that must stay in the correct descending order and correctly paired with each country; models often misorder India and Mongolia, or misstate Nepal's global habitat share (2%) as its global population share (it actually holds nearly 10% of the global population).
Source Title: National Trust for Nature Conservation (NTNC) - First comprehensive report of snow leopard population in Nepal (April 2025)

English Question: Per Nepal Rastra Bank's eleven-month 2082/83 report, what was Nepal's overall Balance of Payments (BoP) surplus in Rs. billion during the review period versus the same period a year earlier, and what was the current account surplus in Rs. billion for the same two periods?
Nepali Question: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिने प्रतिवेदन अनुसार, समीक्षा अवधि र एक वर्षअघिको सोही अवधिमा नेपालको समग्र भुक्तानी सन्तुलन (बीओपी) मुनाफा रु. अर्बमा कति-कति रह्यो, र सोही दुई अवधिको चालु खाता मुनाफा रु. अर्बमा कति-कति रह्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Balance of Payments (BoP) remained at a surplus of Rs. 926.06 billion in the eleven months of 2082/83. The current account remained at a surplus of Rs. 802.06 billion in the same period, compared to a current account surplus of Rs. 321.74 billion in the same eleven months of the previous fiscal year (2081/82).
Gold Answer (NE): भुक्तानी सन्तुलन (बीओपी) आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिनामा रु. ९२६.०६ अर्बको मुनाफामा रहेको छ। सोही अवधिमा चालु खाता रु. ८०२.०६ अर्बको मुनाफामा रहेको छ, जुन अघिल्लो आर्थिक वर्ष (२०८१/८२) को सोही एघार महिनामा रु. ३२१.७४ अर्ब थियो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: two distinct but related large surplus figures (BoP 926.06bn vs current account 802.06bn) for the same period, plus a prior-year comparator (321.74bn); models often conflate BoP surplus with current account surplus or drop the year-over-year comparator.
Source Title: Nepal Rastra Bank - Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation, English (Based on Eleven Months' Data of 2025/26)

English Question: In the eleven months of fiscal year 2082/83, how much foreign direct investment (equity only) did Nepal receive, and how much net capital transfer was recorded, compared to the same period of the previous fiscal year, per Nepal Rastra Bank?
Nepali Question: आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिनामा नेपालले कति प्रत्यक्ष वैदेशिक लगानी (इक्विटी मात्र) प्राप्त गर्‍यो, र कति खुद पुँजीगत हस्तान्तरण दर्ता भयो, अघिल्लो आर्थिक वर्षको सोही अवधिको तुलनामा, नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकका अनुसार?
Gold Answer (EN): Rs. 22.82 billion in foreign direct investment (equity only) was received in the eleven months of 2082/83, up from Rs. 11.07 billion in the same period of the previous fiscal year. Net capital transfer amounted to Rs. 17.03 billion, up from Rs. 8.96 billion a year earlier.
Gold Answer (NE): आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिनामा रु. २२.८२ अर्ब प्रत्यक्ष वैदेशिक लगानी (इक्विटी मात्र) प्राप्त भएको छ, जुन अघिल्लो आर्थिक वर्षको सोही अवधिको रु. ११.०७ अर्बभन्दा बढी हो। खुद पुँजीगत हस्तान्तरण रु. १७.०३ अर्ब रहेको छ, जुन एक वर्षअघि रु. ८.९६ अर्ब थियो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: two separate financial-account indicators (FDI equity vs net capital transfer), each with a current-year and prior-year figure - four numbers total that are easily cross-mixed (e.g., swapping which pair belongs to FDI vs capital transfer).
Source Title: Nepal Rastra Bank - Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation, English (Based on Eleven Months' Data of 2025/26)

English Question: According to Nepal Rastra Bank's eleven-month 2082/83 report, by what percentage did the international price of Brent crude oil increase in mid-June 2026 from a year earlier, and by what percentage did the international price of gold increase over the same period?
Nepali Question: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिने प्रतिवेदन अनुसार, २०२६ जुन मध्यमा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय बजारमा ब्रेन्ट कच्चा तेलको मूल्य एक वर्षअघिको तुलनामा कति प्रतिशतले बढ्यो, र सोही अवधिमा सुनको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मूल्य कति प्रतिशतले बढ्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): The price of Brent crude oil increased 16.63% to USD 88.64 per barrel in mid-June 2026 from USD 76.0 a year ago. The price of gold increased 21.85% to USD 4,185.95 per ounce in mid-June 2026 from USD 3,435.35 a year ago.
Gold Answer (NE): ब्रेन्ट कच्चा तेलको मूल्य २०२६ जुन मध्यमा १६.६३% ले बढेर प्रति ब्यारेल अमेरिकी डलर ८८.६४ पुगेको छ, जुन एक वर्षअघि डलर ७६.० थियो। सुनको मूल्य १६.६३% होइन २१.८५% ले बढेर प्रति औंस अमेरिकी डलर ४,१८५.९५ पुगेको छ, जुन एक वर्षअघि डलर ३,४३५.३५ थियो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: two close double-digit percentage increases (16.63% vs 21.85%) for two different commodities in the same period; models frequently swap which commodity had the larger increase or merge the two percentages into one.
Source Title: Nepal Rastra Bank - Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation, English (Based on Eleven Months' Data of 2025/26)

English Question: In the eleven months of fiscal year 2082/83, what was the Government of Nepal's total revenue mobilization in Rs. billion, and how much of that was tax revenue versus non-tax revenue, according to Nepal Rastra Bank?
Nepali Question: आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को एघार महिनामा नेपाल सरकारको कुल राजस्व परिचालन रु. अर्बमा कति रह्यो, र त्यसमध्ये कर राजस्व र गैर-कर राजस्व कति-कति रह्यो, नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकका अनुसार?
Gold Answer (EN): Total revenue mobilization (including amounts to be transferred to provincial and local governments) stood at Rs. 1,081.31 billion, of which tax revenue amounted to Rs. 981.35 billion and non-tax revenue amounted to approximately Rs. 99.96 billion.
Gold Answer (NE): कुल राजस्व परिचालन (प्रदेश तथा स्थानीय सरकारलाई हस्तान्तरण गरिने रकमसहित) रु. १,०८१.३१ अर्ब रहेको छ, जसमध्ये कर राजस्व रु. ९८१.३५ अर्ब र गैर-कर राजस्व लगभग रु. ९९.९६ अर्ब रहेको छ।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: non-tax revenue is not stated directly in the source and must be derived by subtracting tax revenue from the total (1081.31 - 981.35 = 99.96); models often either invent a different non-tax figure or fail to attempt the subtraction.
Source Title: Nepal Rastra Bank - Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation, English (Based on Eleven Months' Data of 2025/26)

English Question: According to Nepal Demographic and Health Survey (NDHS) data analyzed in a peer-reviewed study, how did Nepal's full childhood vaccination coverage change across the 2001, 2011, and 2016 surveys — did it rise steadily, or did it rise and then fall?
Nepali Question: नेपाल जनसांख्यिक तथा स्वास्थ्य सर्वेक्षण (एनडीएचएस) को तथ्याङ्कमा आधारित एक समकक्ष-समीक्षित (पियर-रिभ्युड) अध्ययन अनुसार, सन् २००१, २०११, र २०१६ को सर्वेक्षणहरूमा नेपालको पूर्ण बाल खोप कभरेज कसरी परिवर्तन भयो — के यो निरन्तर बढ्यो, कि बढेर फेरि घट्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): Full vaccination coverage among infants rose from 65.6% in 2001 to a peak of 87.0% in 2011, but then declined to 77.8% in 2016 — a non-monotonic trend, not a steady increase.
Gold Answer (NE): शिशुहरूमा पूर्ण खोप कभरेज सन् २००१ को ६५.६%बाट बढेर सन् २०११ मा उच्चतम ८७.०% पुगेको थियो, तर त्यसपछि सन् २०१६ मा घटेर ७७.८% मा झरेको थियो — यो निरन्तर वृद्धि नभई बढेर फेरि घट्ने प्रवृत्ति हो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: a non-monotonic (rise-then-fall) trend across three survey years; models strongly default to assuming vaccination coverage improves monotonically over time and often invent a steadily rising figure for 2016 instead of the actual decline.
Source Title: Acharya, Paudel & Dharel - "The trend of full vaccination coverage in infants...in Nepal", BMC Public Health (2019)

English Question: What was Nepal's Secondary Education Examination (SEE) overall pass percentage in 2080 BS, 2081 BS, and 2082 BS (published May 2026) respectively, according to the National Examinations Board?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय परीक्षा बोर्डका अनुसार, नेपालको माध्यमिक शिक्षा परीक्षा (एसईई) को समग्र उत्तीर्ण प्रतिशत सन् २०८० सालमा, २०८१ सालमा, र २०८२ सालमा (मे २०२६ मा प्रकाशित) क्रमशः कति-कति थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): The SEE pass percentage was 47.86% in 2080 BS, 61.81% in 2081 BS, and 65.98% in 2082 BS (published 11 May 2026) - an improvement of 4.17 percentage points from 2081 to 2082.
Gold Answer (NE): एसईईको उत्तीर्ण प्रतिशत सन् २०८० सालमा ४७.८६%, २०८१ सालमा ६१.८१%, र २०८२ सालमा (११ मे २०२६ मा प्रकाशित) ६५.९८% रहेको थियो - जुन २०८१ बाट २०८२ सम्म ४.१७ प्रतिशत विन्दुको सुधार हो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: three consecutive-year pass percentages that are all in a similar 47-66% range and easy to transpose (47.86% vs 61.81% vs 65.98%); models often merge two adjacent years or misstate the percentage-point improvement figure.
Source Title: myRepublica - "NEB publishes SEE 2082 results, nearly 66 percent pass" (May 2026)

English Question: For SEE 2082 (results published May 2026), how many students registered for the exam, how many actually appeared/sat the exam, how many received a passing grade, and how many received a Non-Graded (NG) result?
Nepali Question: एसईई २०८२ (मे २०२६ मा प्रकाशित नतिजा) का लागि कति विद्यार्थीले दर्ता गरे, कतिले वास्तवमा परीक्षा दिए, कतिले उत्तीर्ण ग्रेड पाए, र कतिले नन-ग्रेडेड (एनजी) नतिजा पाए?
Gold Answer (EN): 512,421 students registered for SEE 2082, of whom 430,667 actually appeared/sat the exam. Of those who appeared, 284,160 received a passing grade and 146,507 received a Non-Graded (NG) result.
Gold Answer (NE): एसईई २०८२ का लागि ५,१२,४२१ विद्यार्थीले दर्ता गरेका थिए, जसमध्ये ४,३०,६६७ जनाले वास्तवमा परीक्षा दिए। परीक्षा दिनेमध्ये २,८४,१६० जनाले उत्तीर्ण ग्रेड पाए र १,४६,५०७ जनाले नन-ग्रेडेड (एनजी) नतिजा पाए।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: four distinct large numbers (registered vs appeared vs passed vs NG) where 'registered' and 'appeared' are commonly conflated by models into a single figure, and the 65.98% pass rate is calculated against 'appeared' (430,667), not 'registered' (512,421) - a base-number trap.
Source Title: myRepublica - "NEB publishes SEE 2082 results, nearly 66 percent pass" (May 2026)

English Question: Per the 2019 National Geographic and Rolex Perpetual Planet Everest Expedition study (led by University of Maine researchers), how much thickness has Mount Everest's South Col Glacier lost in the last 25 years, and how many times faster is it thinning compared to the roughly 2,000 years it took to form?
Nepali Question: सन् २०१९ को राष्ट्रिय भौगोलिक (नेशनल जियोग्राफिक) र रोलेक्स पर्पेच्युअल प्लानेट सगरमाथा अभियानको अध्ययन (युनिभर्सिटी अफ मेन का अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरूको नेतृत्वमा) अनुसार, सगरमाथाको साउथ कोल हिमनदीले विगत २५ वर्षमा कति बाक्लोपन (मोटाइ) गुमाएको छ, र यो हिमनदी निर्माण हुन लागेको लगभग २,००० वर्षको तुलनामा कति गुणा छिटो पग्लिरहेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The South Col Glacier, near the summit of Mount Everest (around 7,906-8,020m elevation), has lost up to 55 metres of thickness in the last 25 years, and is thinning more than 80 times faster than the roughly 2,000 years it took to form - a rate that could see it disappear entirely by the middle of this century.
Gold Answer (NE): सगरमाथाको शिखर नजिकैको साउथ कोल हिमनदी (लगभग ७,९०६-८,०२० मिटर उचाइमा) ले विगत २५ वर्षमा ५५ मिटरसम्म बाक्लोपन गुमाएको छ, र यो हिमनदी बन्न लागेको लगभग २,००० वर्षको तुलनामा ८० गुणाभन्दा बढी छिटो पग्लिरहेको छ - यही दरमा यो शताब्दीको मध्यसम्ममा पूर्णतया लोप हुनसक्छ।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: multiple precise, easily-confused figures in one question - elevation (7,906m/8,020m vs Everest's own summit height of 8,849m), thickness lost (55m), formation time (2,000 years), and thinning-rate multiplier (80x); models often substitute Everest's summit elevation for the glacier's elevation or invent a rounder multiplier like '100 times'.
Source Title: National Geographic - "Everest's highest glacier has lost 2,000 years of ice in 30 years" (Univ. of Maine-led study, published in npj Climate and Atmospheric Science)
Source Type: News Media (National Geographic) reporting a peer-reviewed study
